sections.history: MRC dyspnoea grade 3. Morning cough with white sputum. Two exacerbations requiring oral steroids in the last 12 months (one also needed antibiotics); no hospital admissions. Reports ankle swelling. No chest pain, haemoptysis or weight loss. Ex-smoker for 6 months, approximately 40 pack-years. Good inhaler technique with Anoro. Had flu and pneumococcal vaccines.
sections.medications_allergies: Anoro Ellipta (umeclidinium/vilanterol) one inhalation once daily. Salbutamol as needed (about twice daily). No known drug allergies.
sections.examination: SpO2 93% on air, RR 20. Bilateral wheeze. Coarse crackles at the right base (new). Spirometry: FEV1 52% predicted (lower than last year). Blood eosinophils 0.35 × 10⁹/L.
sections.impression: COPD with frequent exacerbations despite LAMA/LABA; eosinophils ≥0.3, suitable for triple therapy. New focal crackles at the left base.
sections.plan: Switch Anoro to Trelegy Ellipta one inhalation once daily. Refer to pulmonary rehabilitation. Chest X-ray today. Clinic review in 3 months.
sections.safety_netting: Contact GP the same day if increased breathlessness, sputum volume or change in sputum colour. Call 999 if severely breathless.
